title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
description:
**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Employment:** Full-time, long-term position  
**Start date:** As soon as possible after selection and agreement  
**Salary:** Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

**About Us**

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
* Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
* Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
* Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
* Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
* Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
* Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
* Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
* Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
* A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
* The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
* Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
* The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
* BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
* UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
* NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
* Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
* Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
* The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
* Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

**Remote Working Arrangement**

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

* Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
* Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
* The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
* Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

title: Software Engineer - IOS
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is looking for a motivated Software Engineer (P2\) to help build and refine our native iOS application. Docusign is redefining how the world handles agreements, moving beyond e\-signatures to a platform that makes agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across the entire agreement lifecycle. Our team's charter is twofold: to support the complex, high\-volume use cases of our enterprise customers while maintaining the world\-class usability and polish that consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a P2 engineer, you will focus on building user\-facing application features, fixing bugs, and improving app performance. You will write clean Swift code, write unit tests, and work alongside senior engineers to grow your technical skills in a collaborative Agile environment.

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Engineering Manager.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Design and build engaging, native user experiences for the Docusign iOS app using Swift
* Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests to ensure high performance and application stability
* Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and backend engineers to turn feature requirements into working mobile software
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks reported by users or automated tools
* Actively participate in team sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews to give and receive constructive feedback
* Stay updated with new Apple features, tools, and iOS updates to help continuous team improvement
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**


* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 1\+ years writing native iOS applications in Swift
* Understanding of iOS application lifecycle, data persistence, network communication with RESTful APIs, and Git version control
* Experience working within an Agile/Scrum team environment

**Preferred**


* Personal or professional app published in the Apple App Store
* Familiarity with SwiftUI alongside UIKit
* Understanding of modern architectural patterns like MVVM
* Exposure to automated testing using XCTest
* Passion for high\-quality UI/UX and Apple Human Interface Guidelines

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer (P4\) to build and scale our Intelligent Agreement Management platform on iOS. Docusign is moving beyond e\-signatures to make agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across their entire lifecycle. Our team supports complex enterprise use cases while maintaining the world\-class usability consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a Senior Engineer, you will lead the technical design of major mobile features and reusable SDK modules using your deep Swift expertise. In this role, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams while mentoring mid\-level engineers to elevate the overall team.

  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Director, Engineering.

  

**Responsibility**


* Feature and SDK Development: Design, build, and maintain complex, high\-performance native iOS app features and modular SDK components using Swift
* Architecture and Design: Drive technical design discussions, author technical specification documents, and ensure codebase modularity, scalability, and maintainability.
* Engineering Excellence: Set high standards for code quality through rigorous code reviews, unit and UI testing, and continuous integration practices.
* Cross\-Functional Partnering: Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA, and backend platform teams to translate product requirements into robust iOS solutions.
* Mentorship and Leadership: Guide and mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, fostering technical growth and sharing best practices across the team.
* Process and Pipeline Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in development workflows, build systems, or testing, and implement proactive solutions to improve velocity.
* Platform Evolution: Stay informed on Apple platform developments, Swift language updates, and iOS design trends, incorporating modern tools and frameworks where appropriate.

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software environments
* 5\+ years specifically building production native iOS applications and reusable libraries in Swift backed by cloud APIs
* Demonstrated experience applying modern iOS architecture patterns (such as MVVM or Clean Architecture) and writing comprehensive unit and functional tests
* Hands\-on experience with Xcode, CI/CD automation, dependency management, and publishing apps to the App Store
* Proven track record of delivering complex technical initiatives iteratively within an Agile team environment

**Preferred**


* Experience developing, packaging, and distributing developer\-facing iOS apps, SDKs or binary frameworks (XCFrameworks)
* Strong proficiency with modern Swift paradigms (such as Async/Await and Combine) alongside deep experience in both SwiftUI and UIKit
* Working knowledge of Objective\-C for maintaining and modernizing existing framework components
* Experience with enterprise mobile security standards, including OAuth/SSO integration, secure storage, and data encryption
* Active involvement in the iOS community, such as tech blogging, open\-source contributions, or conference speaking
